Messages.Author: Smudge the Centre of Attention
Messages.Body: "Each other Methuselah holds between 1 and 4 pool in his or her hand. Guess the amount of pool in each Methuselah's hand. Each time you guess correctly, you gain that pool from his or her pool. If you guess incorrectly, that Methuselah gains that much pool from the blood bank." Do they gain the amount you guessed, or the amount in their hand?
